The save action feels quick, and having the new link appear at the top of Recent is exactly what I expected. The empty message also feels clear.

The guessed title from the address isn’t good enough for me, though—many addresses are cryptic. I’d want the app to pick up the page’s real title automatically, with a way for me to change it if needed. I’d prefer not to have to type a title every time I save a link.
